title: MPV Config Sources
description: Source definitions for pulling portable mpv configuration files from GitHub repositories, releases, and gists.

owner.description: GitHub user or organization that owns the repository or gist.

repo.description: Repository name, or the Gist ID when ref is "gists".

ref.description: A git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA), or a special discriminator: "releases" to download a named asset from the latest GitHub Release, or "gists" to download a file from a GitHub Gist. Omit to use the repository's default branch.

paths.description: File or directory mappings from the remote source to the local destination.

source.description: Path to the file or directory in the remote repository. When both source and destination end with "/", the entire directory tree is copied recursively.

destination.description: Local filesystem path where the file or directory tree should be written.
